meta.description: 小红书风格知识卡片, 多张联排可滑动浏览

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 生成小红书风格的知识卡片，支持多张联排滑动浏览
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果常在小红书发布知识类图文内容
copy.tagline_en: Generate Xiaohongshu-style knowledge cards with multi-card swipeable layout
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often publish knowledge-based visual content on Xiaohongshu

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会生成多张小红书风格的图文卡片，每张尺寸固定，可滑动浏览。第一张是封面，中间每张讲一个核心观点，最后一张是总结加行动号召。
howto.when: 当你要求制作小红书风格的知识卡片或图文内容时触发。

say.text: 帮我做一套小红书卡片，讲5个时间管理技巧。
say.note: 生成封面、3张正文、1张总结共5张卡片。

say.text: 用莫兰迪配色，做3张关于读书方法的卡片。
say.note: 指定配色和数量，生成对应卡片。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude generates multiple Xiaohongshu-style cards in a fixed size, arranged vertically for easy scrolling. The first card is a cover, each middle card presents one core idea, and the last card is a summary with a call to action.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to create Xiaohongshu-style knowledge cards or graphic content.

say_en.text: Create a set of Xiaohongshu cards about 5 time management tips.
say_en.note: Generates a cover, 3 content cards, and 1 summary card.

say_en.text: Use Morandi colors and make 3 cards about reading methods.
